newsitem.title: GERMANY: Lufthansa undecided on selling Hapag stake.
newsitem.headline: Lufthansa undecided on selling Hapag stake.

text.p: Deutsche Lufthansa AG said on Wednesday it had not decided whether to keep its 18 percent stake in shipping and travel firm Hapag Lloyd AG or sell it to bidder Preussag AG.

A Lufthansa spokesman denied a report in the Handelsblatt newspaper that the airline, along with Veba AG and Agfa Gevaert, which also hold 18 percent stakes, wanted to block the sale to Preussag, the diversified steel and engineering firm.
The three had pooled their interests in Hapag Lloyd a long time ago, but there was no pool contract, and it was untrue that they wanted to block the sale, he said.
The spokesman said Preussag had informed the company of its intentions a few days ago.
Preussag said it was negotiating with current shareholders over the price of Hapag Lloyd shares. Cartel authorities indicated they would take a dim view of the deal.
